description: This file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget called DashboardScreen, which displays the user's session token and provides a logout button. It interacts with a session storage service to load and clear the token, and navigates to the login screen upon logout.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the dashboard page that shows user session info and logout option.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: The state class for DashboardScreen managing token loading and UI rendering.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Loads the access token asynchronously from session storage.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the dashboard screen.
